Why Andori

What Sets Us Apart

We don't just build — we take full ownership of your project. Precision, communication, and a standard most builders simply don't match.

01

End-to-End Project Management

From first consultation to final inspection, we manage every trade, timeline, and detail. One point of contact — zero stress on your end.

02

Fully Licensed and Insured

Andori Building Group holds full builder's registration and comprehensive insurance. Your home and investment are protected at every stage.

03

Premium Finishes, Always

We refuse to cut corners. Whether it's a custom live-edge vanity or a full outdoor alfresco, every detail is executed to the highest standard.

04

Transparent, Fixed Quotes

No surprise costs halfway through your build. Detailed, itemised quotes upfront so you know exactly what you're getting and what it costs.

05

On-Time Delivery

We respect your time and your home. Our builds run to schedule with clear milestones and a team that shows up when they say they will.

06

Built on Relationships

Most of our work comes through referrals. We're building long-term trust with Melbourne homeowners who come back to us again and again.
